description.title: הגדרות פוליסה
description.summary: This table defines terms used in a business insurance policy, specifically a pollution liability policy. It provides definitions for key terms used throughout the policy document.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מגדירה מונחים המשמשים בפוליסת ביטוח עסקית, במיוחד בפוליסת אחריות זיהום. מונחים אלו חיוניים להבנת הכיסוי והתנאים של הפוליסה. ניתן לחפש הגדרות לפי מונח, כגון ״מיכל אחסון תת-קרקעי״ או ״ערך שימוש״. המונחים המוגדרים כוללים ״נבגים״, ״סיום הכיסוי״, ״מיכל אחסון תת-קרקעי״, ״ערך שימוש״, ״פרמיה״ וחישוב ״יחס ישר״. הגדרות אלו מסייעות להבהיר את היקף הכיסוי של הפוליסה ואת החובות של המבוטח.
notable_values: מיכל אחסון תת-קרקעי: נפח של לפחות 10%
ערך שימוש: ערך משאבים טבעיים לציבור

sketch:
AA. "Spore" or 'spores' means any reproductive body produced by or arising out of any 'fungus(i)".
BB. "Termination  of  coverage" means,  for  the  purpose  of  EXTENDED  REPORTING PERIODS (Section V.), the effective date of:
Cancellation or nonrenewal of this policy by the "named insured", or cancellation or nonrenewal of this policy by us other than for fraud or material misrepresentation,  change  in  use  of,  or  operations  conducted  at,  the  "covered location",; or
Deletion  of  a  'covered  location'  from  this  policy  by  us  upon  the  "named insured's" written request but only with respect to such 'covered location".
"Underground storage tank" means any tank in existence at a "covered location" as of  the  inception  date  of  the  policy  or  installed  thereafter,  including  associated underground  piping  connected  thereto,  that  has  at  least  ten  (10)  percent  of  its volume, or any associated piping, below the ground.
'Use value ' means the value of the "natural resources" to the public attributable to the  direct  use  of  the  services  provided  by  such  "natural  resources",  provided, however, that no aesthetic or historic use shall be considered in the determination of such value.
EE. Pro rata' is calculated as: Earned Premium = (days of coverage)/365 x 'Premium".
FF. "Premium' equals the total premium reflected on the declarations page.

BB. "Termination  of  coverage" means,  for  the  purpose  of  EXTENDED  REPORTING PERIODS (Section V.), the effective date of:

Deletion  of  a  'covered  location'  from  this  policy  by  us  upon  the  "named insured's" written request but only with respect to such 'covered location".
"Underground storage tank" means any tank in existence at a "covered location" as of  the  inception  date  of  the  policy  or  installed  thereafter,  including  associated underground  piping  connected  thereto,  that  has  at  least  ten  (10)  percent  of  its volume, or any associated piping, below the ground.
'Use value ' means the value of the "natural resources" to the public attributable to the  direct  use  of  the  services  provided  by  such  "natural  resources",  provided, however, that no aesthetic or historic use shall be considered in the determination of such value.
EE. Pro rata' is calculated as: Earned Premium = (days of coverage)/365 x 'Premium".
